provenance.source: Nan.Builders catalog docs page (docs/models) — an HTML page with no machine-readable API; no live endpoint exists to fetch (exploration #280, open question 2).
provenance.method: Offline transcription of the exploration record into the design/spec field vocabulary. Only values present in that record appear; fields the record does not carry for a model (e.g. per-model modalities not transcribed) are omitted, never invented. `name` is the display form of the docs model id; per-model display names were not part of the record.
provenance.contextNotation: Docs labels map to binary token counts: 1M → 1048576, 262K → 262144, 256K → 262144 — consistent with the 262144-family values used in CONFIG.
provenance.quotaPolicy: NaN publishes per-member quotas and rate limits instead of pricing; this snapshot therefore carries quota metadata and no pricing of any kind (spec Definitions: Snapshot).
provenance.excludedNote: Non-chat docs entries (embeddings, rerank, TTS, STT, image) are listed for completeness but excluded from `models`: they have no ModelConfig representation in the add-model flow.
